worldcombat.skill.rapidspin.summary: Spins in place into a ring of wind that shakes off Bind, Wrap and Leech Seed, sweeps and shoves nearby enemies outward, then raises the user's Speed by one stage. Wide mode sweeps further, tight mode spins heavier.
worldcombat.skill.rapidspin.use.0: Break free while bound, wrapped or seeded
worldcombat.skill.rapidspin.use.1: Spin a surrounding crowd off when boxed in
worldcombat.skill.rapidspin.use.2: Pick up a stage of Speed along the way
Spins a %2$s block ring in place; every enemy caught takes %1$s contact damage.
Spin %1$s times and push targets back %2$s blocks. Clear roots, traps and Leech Seed, then raise Speed by %3$s stages.
The spin throws about %1$s wind motes.
worldcombat.skill.rapidspin.wide.on: Wide: ring radius x1.3, denser motes and x1.15 knockback to sweep a bigger circle, at the cost of x0.9 power, +2 ticks wind-up and +8 ticks cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.rapidspin.wide.off: Tight: power x1.1, a faster wind-up and a shorter cooldown, but it only reaches those pressed against the user.
worldcombat.skill.rapidspin.timing: Castable within %1$s blocks; after a %2$s wind-up it spends %4$s PP, recovers for %3$s, and goes on cooldown for %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.rapidspin.growth.0: From level %1$s the sweep rises to %2$s power and the ring grows to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.rapidspin.growth.1: From level %1$s the sweep rises again to %2$s power and the wind motes rise to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.rapidspin.preference.w: On: ring radius x1.3, denser motes and x1.15 knockback to sweep a bigger circle, at the cost of x0.9 power, +2 ticks wind-up and +8 ticks cooldown. Off (tight): power x1.1, a faster wind-up and a shorter cooldown, but it only reaches those pressed against the user.
worldcombat.skill.rapidspin.preference.a: Without a bind, the companion only spins once a threat is within this distance; larger values make it spin and speed up earlier, and more often into nothing.
On: a target with other enemies within 3.5 blocks ranks higher, so one spin sweeps a whole circle. Off: ordinary self-defence ordering.
